audits.comment: Cutoff is 'first built' per LAHD, so construction_completed basis. State Civ. Code 1947.12(d)(3) exempts housing under stricter local control.

tenant has not lived in unit six months or original lease not expired

audits.comment: JCO covers most properties not under the RSO, including older single-family homes, so a 'built after 1978' cutoff would wrongly exclude them; cutoff removed. Overlap with RSO units cannot be separated from parcel data.

unverifiable_exemptions: single-family dwellings owned by natural persons (one month's rent)

audits.comment: Applies to both RSO and JCO units; no parcel-checkable limits.

only applies when demolished for new construction and tenant is lower-income

audits.comment: All RSO units are Protected Units; other units depend on unverifiable history. Works alongside state Housing Crisis Act.

unverifiable_exemptions: Other RSO exemptions cannot be checked from parcel data
